scope: Read-only source-contract and existing scalar-receipt analysis, plus documentation reconciliation with the prospective scalar model; no numerical RTE experiment, SSH or original-source export

units.gamma_n: n*u/(1-n*u), only if n*u<1 and stated operation assumptions hold

material_contract.transformed_t_s: formed in data dtype before make_operator/setup
material_contract.high_buffers: exact entry promotion of stored low directions/weights/phase/kx/ky and t/s/source; stream products are reassembled64
material_contract.high_target: stored discrete promoted-buffer action, not continuum or newly generated double geometry
material_contract.low_native128: complex128 application with original low float32 stream formation and promoted original cache; not high.A_op

operation_contract.stream_symbol: two real stored-coefficient products and one real addition in operator.float_dtype, then imaginary embedding
operation_contract.streaming: one spatial fftn and ifftn, backward normalization
operation_contract.scattering: weight*field, phase einsum, then sigma_s multiplication, in field dtype
operation_contract.physical_action: streaming plus total collision then subtract scattering
operation_contract.reference_setup: means in low float_dtype; phase*weight formed32 before complex64 reference matrix/inverse
operation_contract.reference_application: inverse cache promoted to RHS dtype without reinversion; one spatial FFT/IFFT pair

outer_contract.deployed_M: complex128 input cast64, original fixed TSA8/16, fresh owned128 return
outer_contract.physical_images: original high.A_op of each actual returned Z; no low-HZ substitution
outer_contract.original_real_geometry: float64 concatenated real/imaginary channels; no real-field restriction
outer_contract.complex_geometry: complex128 Hermitian MGS and small SVD
outer_contract.intermediate_residual: rounded initial defect minus high action of correction
outer_contract.final_residual: fresh source minus high action of rounded initial-plus-correction field

not_recorded_by_frozen_driver: global default dtype and flush/subnormal behavior

prospective_budget_model.hypothesis: Uniform original-physical-high action error norm(e_H(x)) <= epsilon_H*norm(x); conditional scalar/kernel contracts are not inferred globally from finite probes
prospective_budget_model.hypothetical_measured_residual_ceiling: rho_hat=(1-f)*tau with f=0.01; conditional certificate slack only, not a changed solver stopping rule
prospective_budget_model.norm_contract: abs(n_hat-n)<=nu*n; nu_r=nu_q=gamma_(4*D+16)(u64), D=complex field count; assumed effective norm/reduction contract, not a validated backend theorem
prospective_budget_model.residual_subtraction_contract: norm(delta_sub)<=mu_sub*(norm(q)+norm(Hhat(x))); assumed mu_sub=u64 in the current model
prospective_budget_model.unchanged_exact_tau_sufficient_condition: b<=m*(tau-rho_upper-a)/(1+tau), requiring a positive available allowance
prospective_budget_model.physical_Lambda: max(abs(s_high))+max(t)+max(s)*upper_norm(P), including the model conservative symbol-formation allowance
prospective_budget_model.required_fft_contract: Largest sufficient equal relative forward/inverse FFT64 allowance found against the declared conditional_action_bound; derived before measurements, not fitted; not an established global backend contract
prospective_budget_model.budget_reserve: All physical-action, residual-subtraction and norm uncertainty are paid inside the fixed one-percent reserve; no enlarged exact target or separate allowance outside the reserve
prospective_budget_model.fixture_scope: New4x4 toy from copied stored geometry/sample coefficients; exact roots-of-unity oracle for that toy only, not full-N authority or global cuFFT bound
prospective_budget_model.status: Source/math proposal only; parent owns prospective protocol and execution. Prior failed mandatory protocol and results remain unchanged.
